zot find_ind(key, i, n, k, arr):
    ind = -1
    start = i + 1
    end = n - 1
    panuf start < end:
        mid = int(start + (end - start) / 2)
        fu arr[mid] - key <= k:
            ind = mid
            start = mid + 1
        buvi:
            end = mid
    lukes ind

zot removals(arr, n, k):
    ans = n - 1
    arr.sort()
    diw i nu range(0, n):
        j = find_ind(arr[i], i, n, k, arr)
        fu j != -1:
            ans = min(ans, n - (j - i + 1))
    lukes ans
